description.en: Deals #1[i]% of Blade's ATK as Wind DMG to a target enemy.
description.zh-CN: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于刃#1[i]%攻击力的风属性伤害。

summary.en: Deals minor Wind DMG to an enemy.
summary.zh-CN: 对敌方单体造成少量风属性伤害。

description.en:
Consumes HP equal to #1[i]% of Blade's Max HP to enter the Hellscape state.
When Hellscape is active, his Skill cannot be used, his DMG dealt increases by #4[i]%, and his Basic ATK Shard Sword is enhanced to Forest of Swords for #2[i] turn(s).
If Blade's current HP is insufficient, his HP will be reduced to 1 when he uses his Skill.
This Skill does not regenerate Energy. Using this Skill does not end the current turn.
description.zh-CN:
消耗等同于刃生命上限#1[i]%的生命值，进入【地狱变】状态。
处于【地狱变】状态时无法施放战技，同时使自身造成的伤害提高#4[i]%，普攻【支离剑】强化为【无间剑树】，持续#2[i]回合。
若当前生命值不足，施放战技时刃的当前生命值降低至1点。
该战技无法恢复能量。施放该战技后，本回合不会结束。

summary.en: Consumes HP to Enhance Basic ATK, and this turn does not end after this Skill is used.
summary.zh-CN: 消耗自身生命值，获得强化普攻，且本回合不会结束。

description.en:
Sets Blade's current HP to 50% of his Max HP and deals Wind DMG to one enemy equal to the sum of #1[i]% of his ATK, #2[i]% of his Max HP, and #5[i]% of the tally of Blade's HP loss in the current battle. At the same time, deals Wind DMG to adjacent targets equal to the sum of #3[f1]% of his ATK, #4[i]% of his Max HP, and #6[i]% of the tally of his HP loss in the current battle.
The tally of Blade's HP loss in the current battle is capped at #7[i]% of his Max HP. This value will be reset and re-accumulated after his Ultimate has been used.
description.zh-CN:
将刃的当前生命值转化为生命上限的50%，并对敌方单体造成等同于刃#1[i]%攻击力+#2[i]%生命上限+#5[i]%本场战斗中累计已损失生命值的风属性伤害，同时对其相邻目标造成等同于刃#3[f1]%攻击力+#4[i]%生命上限+#6[i]%本场战斗中累计已损失生命值的风属性伤害。
本场战斗中累计已损失生命值最高不超过刃生命上限的#7[i]%，施放终结技后会清空并进行重新累计。

summary.en: Sets current HP to 50% of Max HP, and deals massive Wind DMG to one enemy and Wind DMG to adjacent targets.
summary.zh-CN: 将当前生命值转化为生命上限的50%，并对敌方单体造成大量风属性伤害，对相邻目标造成风属性伤害。

description.en:
When Blade sustains DMG or consumes his HP, he gains 1 stack of Charge, stacking up to 5 times. A max of 1 Charge stack can be gained every time he is attacked.
When Charge stack reaches maximum, immediately launches a Follow-Up ATK on all enemies, dealing Wind DMG equal to #2[i]% of Blade's ATK plus #4[i]% of his Max HP. At the same time, restores Blade's HP by #3[i]% of his Max HP. After the Follow-Up ATK, all Charges are consumed.
description.zh-CN:
刃受到伤害或消耗生命值时，获得1层充能，最多叠加5层。该效果每次受到攻击最多叠加1层。
当充能叠加至上限时，立即对敌方全体施放1次追加攻击，造成等同于刃#2[i]%攻击力+#4[i]%生命上限的风属性伤害并回复等同于刃生命上限#3[i]%的生命值，施放追加攻击后，消耗所有充能。

summary.en: When Blade's HP decreases, gains 1 stack of Charge. Upon reaching maximum Charge, launches Follow-Up ATK, dealing Wind DMG to all enemies, restoring HP, and consuming all Charges.
summary.zh-CN: 刃的生命值降低时，获得1层充能。充能达到上限时发动追加攻击，对敌方全体造成风属性伤害并回复生命值，消耗所有充能。

description.en: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.
description.zh-CN: 攻击敌人，进入战斗后削弱敌方目标对应属性韧性。

name.en: Blade Cuts the Deepest in Hell

description.en:
Blade's Ultimate deals additionally increased DMG to one designated enemy target, with the increased amount equal to 150% of the tally of Blade's HP loss in the current battle.
The tally of Blade's HP loss in the current battle is capped at 90% of his Max HP. The tally value will be reset and re-accumulated after his Ultimate has been used.
description.zh-CN:
终结技对指定敌方单体造成的伤害额外提高，提高数值等同于刃150%本场战斗中累计的已损失生命值。
本场战斗中累计已损失生命值最高不超过刃生命上限的90%，施放终结技后会清空并进行重新累计。

name.en: Ten Thousand Sorrows From One Broken Dream

description.en: When Blade is in the Hellscape state, his CRIT Rate increases by 15%.
description.zh-CN: 刃处于【地狱变】状态时，暴击率提高15%。

description.en:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
description.zh-CN: 终结技等级+2，最多不超过15级；天赋等级+2，最多不超过15级。

name.en: Rejected by Death, Infected With Life

description.en: When Blade's current HP percentage drops to 50% or lower of his Max HP, increases his Max HP by 20%. Stacks up to 2 time(s).
description.zh-CN: 当前生命值百分比从大于50%降低至小于等于50%时，生命上限提高20%，该效果最多叠加2层。

description.en:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
description.zh-CN: 战技等级+2，最多不超过15级；普攻等级+1，最多不超过10级。

description.en: The maximum number of Charge stacks is reduced to 4. The Follow-Up ATK triggered by Talent deals additionally increased DMG, with the increased amount equal to 50% of Blade's Max HP.
description.zh-CN: 充能的层数上限降低至4层。天赋触发追加攻击造成的伤害额外提高，提高数值等同于刃50%的生命上限。

description.en: When Blade's current HP percentage is at 50% of Max HP or lower, the HP restored when receiving healing increases by #1[i]%.
description.zh-CN: 刃的当前生命值百分比小于等于生命上限的50%时，受到治疗时的回复量提高#1[i]%。

description.en: If Blade hits a Weakness Broken enemy after using "Forest of Swords," he will restore HP equal to #1[i]% of his Max HP plus #2[i].
description.zh-CN: 施放【无间剑树】后，若击中处于弱点击破状态的敌方目标，刃回复等同于自身#1[i]%生命上限+#2[i]的生命值。

description.en: Increases DMG dealt by the Talent's Follow-Up ATK by #1[i]%.
description.zh-CN: 天赋施放的追加攻击伤害提高#1[i]%。

description.en: When Blade uses Ultimate, the amount cleared from the tally of HP loss is changed to #1[i]%.
description.zh-CN: 刃施放终结技清空的累计已损失生命值改为#1[i]%。

description.en: HP restored from healing increases by #2[i]%. After receiving healing, converts #1[i]% of the healed amount to Ultimate's tally of HP loss.
description.zh-CN: 受到治疗时的回复量提高#2[i]%。接受治疗后会将#1[i]%的治疗数值转化为终结技的累计已损失生命值。

description.en: Increases Follow-Up ATK DMG from Talent by #1[i]% and additionally regenerates #2[i] Energy.
description.zh-CN: 天赋施放的追加攻击伤害提高#1[i]%，并额外恢复#2[i]点能量。
